title: Mailchimp Marketing API key: must not be flagged (tool-corroborated)
summary: 1 input related to Mailchimp Marketing API key that resemble the format but are not issued credentials (a bare prefix, a short body, a mask or a reference).
rationale: A value that only resembles a credential is not one. Reporting it is a false alarm, and it shows whether structure and context, not appearance, decide the outcome.

expectation.rationale: Public identifier constructed to contain no credential: silence follows from construction.
